title: Google Workspace + Gemini Enterprise Target Architecture Blueprint (Enterprise/150k+)
author_notes: Effort tier: T5 (Google Workspace + Gemini enterprise transformation; architecture/governance/integration or migration work, live-environment care).

Google Admin console + Microsoft/Entra authored click-by-click from public docs; Gemini Enterprise preview/rolling-out capabilities cited or flagged 'verify in tenant', never invented; third-party migration-tool and enterprise-app internals deferred to vendor docs.
hook: Own the end-state before the vendors start building
problem: In a 150k-user shift from Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace and Gemini, whoever owns the target architecture owns the outcome. This blueprint defines the end-state Google Workspace + Gemini + identity architecture and the architectural principles that govern every workstream — email/calendar/collaboration, Drive replacement, identity integration, data governance/retention, and AI enablement — so the transformation stays scalable, supportable, and under enterprise control rather than fragmenting across partners.
whats_inside: Architecture Overview — the end-state Google Workspace + Gemini + identity architecture and how the workstreams fit together, with the enterprise principles that constrain every design.

Architecture Domains — principles and reference patterns for email/calendar/collaboration, Drive / SharePoint replacement, identity integration (Entra ID / SSO / provisioning), data governance & retention (Vault / Purview coexistence), and AI enablement (Gemini + agentic).
Decision Records & Standards — a reusable set of architecture decision records (ADRs), non-functional requirements, and enterprise standards the program measures designs against.

5 assessment/validation scripts — current-state discovery across the M365/Entra source, an architecture-conformance validation, a coverage/gap report, safe remediation guidance, and a scope/target-group helper.

Governance hooks & a Target-Architecture document template — how the blueprint feeds the Architecture Review Board, plus Testing/validation gates and Best Practices for keeping the architecture authoritative.
short: Define and own the end-state Google Workspace + Gemini + identity architecture for a 150k-user transformation — principles for collaboration, Drive replacement, identity, governance, and AI — so it stays scalable, supportable, and under enterprise control. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
